population.description: Most cells drift slowly toward the Point of Audio, averaging 1.2 µm per minute. They also turn gently counterclockwise around it. 75% of cells follow this pattern. We found 5 groups; one small group moves outward, which is unusual.

reliability.note: 9 cells were lost for a few frames where nuclei overlapped, mostly near the top edge.

clusters.name: Steady inward drifters
clusters.description: The most typical group. These cells move steadily toward the Point of Audio and turn gently counterclockwise, just like the population as a whole.

clusters.name: Fast circlers
clusters.description: The fastest group. They mostly circle counterclockwise around the Point of Audio and come closer only slowly.

clusters.name: Slow edge cells
clusters.description: Cells near the edge of the dish. They move slowly and only slightly inward.

clusters.name: Near-center pausers
clusters.description: Cells already close to the Point of Audio. They have mostly stopped moving.

clusters.name: Outward movers
clusters.description: Unusual: this small group moves away from the Point of Audio while everyone else moves toward it. Worth a closer look.

cells.description: Cell 12 starts in the top left and moves steadily toward the Point of Audio.

events.text: Starts 210 µm from the Point of Audio, moving slowly.
